posts.title: The most underutilized linters feature: severity levels
posts.description: Linters have many rules. Not all rules are equally helpful. Some rules prevent bugs in the code, some enforce good practices, and some enforce code style. Our configured linters usually are very vocal about “errors” in our code while our code is perfectly working. Just its style doesn’t follow specified guidelines. It results in constant unproductive noise from linters. Didn’t add a space — error.
